mentions.name: Miles Bridges
mentions.analysis: Brandon Miller's injury is giving more minutes to Miles Bridges, and he's playing really well off LaMelo Ball. This might be a good time to sell high on him.

mentions.name: Norman Powell
mentions.analysis: Norman Powell has been playing really well in the absence of Paul George and Kawhi Leonard. It's suggested to consider selling high on him.

mentions.name: Gabe Vincent
mentions.analysis: Gabe Vincent is getting more minutes with the Lakers, and in deep leagues, he could be a valuable pickup.

mentions.name: Max Christie
mentions.analysis: Max Christie can be a points wipe and is getting more minutes with the Lakers, making him a potential pickup in deep leagues.

mentions.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
mentions.analysis: Kelly Oubre Jr. is getting a lot of playing time and producing points, making him a must-add to lineups.

mentions.name: Grady Dick
mentions.analysis: With RJ Barrett yet to play, Grady Dick might come into lineups, so it's worth keeping an eye on him.

mentions.name: Noah Clowney
mentions.analysis: Noah Clowney has been dropped in a lot of teams, and with the Nets having a four-game week, he could be a valuable pickup.

mentions.name: Dean Wade
mentions.analysis: Dean Wade has been getting extra minutes lately, making him a potential pickup.

mentions.name: Ty Jerome
mentions.analysis: Ty Jerome is doing a good job as one of the backups in Cleveland, making him a potential pickup.

mentions.name: Gary Trent Jr.
mentions.analysis: Gary Trent Jr. might be available in some lineups and could be a valuable pickup for streaming purposes.

mentions.name: Jordan Hawkins
mentions.analysis: Jordan Hawkins is a must-add in the interim as he is going to get a lot of playing time with the Pelicans.

mentions.name: Nick Richards
mentions.analysis: Nick Richards is a good add for a center, especially if Mark Williams plays only one game in the week.

mentions.name: Keon Ellis
mentions.analysis: Keon Ellis is an excellent player who could break into the rotation and get more minutes based on matchups.

mentions.name: Alex Caruso
mentions.analysis: Alex Caruso is a good pickup if you're chasing steals, as he is likely to be streamed throughout the week.
